I ordered Neer Dosa with Chicken Sukka, Chicken biryani and chicken ghee roast.

Neer dosa with chicken sukka makes for a delicious, comforting meal. The Neer Dosa was incredibly soft and thin, almost like a delicate, airy wrap that absorbed all the flavors of the Chicken Sukka wonderfully. The Chicken Sukka had a great balance of medium spice. The chicken was tender, and the spices were rich, complementing the mildness of the neer dosa. It’s the perfect combination, where the softness of the dosa and the boldness of the chicken curry come together harmoniously. Definitely a satisfying dish if you love a bit of spice with a light, fluffy side!

Chicken biryani:- chicken was so juicy and tender. The aroma of the chicken biryani was so pleasant. Quantity of the biryani was good.

Chicken ghee roast :- The chicken was perfectly cooked, juicy, and packed with bold flavors. It goes well with neer dosa. If you are fan of spicy food then this dish is for you.
